one_line: A dedicated Meitei scholar bridging ancient copper-plate inscriptions and the modern revival of Meitei Mayek.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but sturdy build, average height.
appearance.face: Soft oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, slightly full lips, gentle yet determined almond-shaped eyes with dark irises, a small beauty mark near the left cheek, default expression calm and focused with a hint of quiet pride.
appearance.hair: Straight, thick black hair tied into a neat low bun at the back of the head; a few controlled strands framing the temples; a simple narrow white cotton headband wrapped once around the forehead, knotted discreetly at the back.
appearance.costume: He wears a traditional Meitei phanek-like lower wrap tailored for modest male wear in a muted deep indigo cotton with subtle horizontal white pinstripes, wrapped securely around the waist and falling to the ankles; over this, a long-sleeved off-white cotton kurta-style tunic reaching mid-thigh with side slits, a simple round neck and no buttons; across his torso is a light grey cotton shawl (inaphi-style) draped from the left shoulder to the right hip, its border bearing a narrow maroon stripe; his feet are in plain brown leather open sandals; he wears a thin red cotton waistband peeking above the wrap, and a simple brass bangle on his right wrist symbolising continuity with older eras; the textiles are matte handwoven cotton with a subtle uneven weave suggesting local looms.
appearance.signature: A sturdy palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with red cord in his left hand and, in his right, a slim wooden stylus whose handle is carved with the Meitei Mayek letter for “k” (kok), with a folded modern newspaper in Meitei script tucked under his arm.

ref_desc: A Meitei male scholar with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a low bun with a white headband, wearing an off-white long-sleeved tunic, deep indigo striped wrap, light grey shawl with maroon border and brown sandals, holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle and carved wooden stylus with a folded Meitei-script newspaper.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Meitei male scholar from Manipur, late 20s, with an oval medium-brown face, determined almond eyes and a small beauty mark on his left cheek, straight black hair tied into a neat low bun and a simple white cotton headband around his forehead. Show him in an off-white long-sleeved cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh, worn over a deep indigo handwoven cotton wrap skirt with subtle horizontal white pinstripes that reaches his ankles, secured with a thin red cotton waistband. Drape a light grey cotton shawl from his left shoulder to right hip, its border marked by a narrow maroon stripe, and put plain brown leather open sandals on his feet and a simple brass bangle on his right wrist. Place in his left hand a bound bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with red cord, and in his right hand a slim wooden stylus whose handle is carved with a single Meitei Mayek letter, while a folded newspaper printed in Meitei script is tucked under his arm. Use a restrained palette of off-white, deep indigo, maroon, light grey and brown leather, and present him from front, side and back to clearly show hair, garments and accessories in consistent detail.
